settings.title: What is it?
settings.content: Skinny Sips Herbal Kehwa Loose Blend is Laushe's signature weight-loss kehwa in a pure, loose-leaf format — a Sunnah-blessed blend of natural herbs and botanicals crafted to boost metabolism, curb appetite, and support healthy fat loss, one soothing cup at a time.

settings.title: Benefits

Targets stubborn fat and helps burn calories faster
Boosts metabolism to turn food into energy efficiently
Cleanses your body naturally by flushing out toxins
Supports a flatter stomach and smoother digestion

settings.title: How to use
settings.content:
Each pouch contains 150g of loose herbal blend — roughly a 4-6 week supply
Add 1 heaped teaspoon per cup and steep in hot water for 5-7 minutes
Enjoy after each main meal, up to 3 times daily for best results

settings.heading: Skinny Sips Loose Blend vs. Other Brands

settings.question: Can I use Skinny Sips Loose Blend without dieting?
settings.answer: Yes, it's designed to support your body naturally, even without strict dieting. However, combining it with a balanced diet and an active lifestyle can help you achieve faster and more noticeable results.

settings.question: How is the loose blend different from the sachet version?
settings.answer: Both use the same herbal recipe. The loose blend lets you control the strength of each cup and brew fresh leaves directly, while sachets offer pre-measured convenience.

settings.question: How should I store the loose blend?
settings.answer: Keep the pouch sealed in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight to preserve freshness and potency for up to 12 months.

settings.question: Is it safe for daily use?
settings.answer: Yes, it's made with natural herbal ingredients and is safe for regular use when taken as directed. If you have any medical conditions or are pregnant, it's best to consult your doctor before use.

settings.question: What results can I expect with regular use?
settings.answer: With consistent use, many users notice reduced bloating, better digestion, and gradual weight loss within a few weeks. Continued use supports long-term results and a healthier routine.
